title: platylepis constricta
intro: Platylepis constricta, commonly known as the "Mountain Orchid", is a type of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to treat various respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Platylepis constricta include its use in treating respiratory problems and as an expectorant, helping to remove mucus and phlegm from the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
